unitEvidence.section: 1.4.2 starts on printed page 12; explicit raster ASCII metre unit statement on printed page 13 (PDF page 12). At most two decimals does not imply centimetre accuracy.
unitEvidence.tenderSections: 4.3–4.3.2, Allegato A printed page 16 (PDF page 41): updated 5 m ground DTM must comply with Level 3 of this specification; ASCII output required.
unitEvidence.specificationHost: Third-party mirror of the primary specification; not an official government host. Detailed documentary review: data/napoli-dtm-2020/vertical-reference-review.json.
